decisions.briefing: Market was neutral today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.6%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($89.29) is far below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new buys were made despite 3 open slots — holding existing positions and waiting for a genuine high-conviction setup.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the Nasdaq up 0.4% and the S&P 500 up 0.6%, in a quiet, low-conviction session. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, suggesting investors were digesting recent data without a clear directional bias. This kind of narrow, broad-based grind higher is typical of a consolidation phase rather than a strong trend day.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚，那斯達克指數上漲0.4%，標普500指數上漲0.6%，屬於缺乏明確方向的清淡交易日。市場未見單一主導消息面，顯示投資人仍在消化近期數據，尚未形成明顯方向。這種窄幅齊漲的走勢，較符合盤整格局，而非強勢趨勢日。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Not every trading day calls for action — sometimes the right move is to do nothing and let your existing positions play out. Forcing a trade just to 'use' available cash or slots, especially on a neutral day, adds risk without a real edge; waiting for a clear, multi-signal setup usually pays off better.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 並非每個交易日都需要進場操作——有時候最好的策略就是按兵不動，讓現有持股自然發展。在市場方向不明的日子裡，為了「用掉」現金額度或空缺倉位而勉強交易，只會增加風險卻沒有真正優勢；耐心等待訊號齊備的高勝率機會，通常成效更佳。
